name: Income Certificate (வருமானச் சான்றிதழ்)
short_description: Official Revenue Department certificate certifying the total annual income of a family from all legal sources, required for government schemes, scholarships, fee concessions, and hostel admissions.
benefits: Valid proof of family income for 1 financial year; unlocks fee waivers, scholarships, and social welfare schemes.
required_documents: Applicant Photo
Aadhaar Card (or Voter ID / Driving License)
Smart / Digital Ration Card (Family Card)
Salary Certificate / Pay Slip (for salaried employees) or Self-Declaration of income
Land Ownership Documents (Patta / Chitta / Adangal) if agricultural income is declared
Income Tax Returns (ITR) if applicable
how_to_apply: Register for a Citizen Access Number (CAN) on the Tamil Nadu e-Sevai citizen portal (tnesevai.tn.gov.in) or visit any Arasu e-Sevai Centre. The Village Administrative Officer (VAO) and Revenue Inspector (RI) will verify before the Tahsildar digitally issues it (Service fee: ₹60).
deadline: No deadline (apply as needed; processing takes 7 to 15 working days)

name: Community Certificate (சாதிச் சான்றிதழ்)
short_description: Official document certifying the social caste/community (SC, ST, BC, MBC, DNC) of a citizen, essential for school/college admissions, reservation benefits, and government recruitments.
benefits: Permanent validity (does not expire). Enables reservation quotas in education and employment.
required_documents: Applicant Photo
Aadhaar Card of Applicant
Smart Ration Card
Community Certificate of Father, Mother, or Siblings (Crucial Proof)
School Transfer Certificate (TC) or Study Certificate showing caste/religion
Self-Declaration Form
how_to_apply: Apply through the Tamil Nadu e-Sevai portal (tnesevai.tn.gov.in) with your CAN number or through an Arasu e-Sevai Centre. Verification is done by the VAO/RI and digitally signed by the Zonal Deputy Tahsildar / Tahsildar.
deadline: No deadline (issued permanently; processing time: 15 working days)

name: Nativity / Residence Certificate (இருப்பிடச் சான்றிதழ்)
short_description: Official certification confirming that an individual is a native or continuous resident of Tamil Nadu, compulsory for state government quotas in higher education and TNPSC recruitments.
benefits: Proves state domicile for state quotas in MBBS, Engineering (TNEA), and government jobs.
required_documents: Applicant Photo
Aadhaar Card
Smart Ration Card
Proof of continuous residence of at least 5 years in Tamil Nadu (e.g. School TC, Mark sheets, Property tax receipt, or Rental agreement)
Birth Certificate of Applicant (if born in Tamil Nadu)
Parent's Nativity / Community / TC document
how_to_apply: Log in to the e-Sevai portal (tnesevai.tn.gov.in) using your CAN ID, upload proofs of continuous stay, and pay ₹60. The Tahsildar approves after VAO/RI field verification.
deadline: No deadline (processing takes about 7 to 15 working days)

name: Birth Certificate (பிறப்புச் சான்றிதழ்)
short_description: The first legal identity document recording the birth of a child, issued under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act by local municipal/panchayat registrar.
benefits: Primary proof of age and parentage for school admission, passport, Aadhaar, voter ID, and citizenship.
required_documents: Hospital Discharge Summary / Birth Report Form (Form-1) if born in a medical facility
Parents' Aadhaar Cards
Marriage Certificate / Proof of marriage of parents (if requested)
Address Proof (Smart Ration Card / Electricity Bill)
Affidavit / Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) sanction if delayed beyond 1 year
how_to_apply: If born in hospital, the hospital registers it directly on crsorgi.gov.in / TN Town Panchayat or Corporation portal. For home births, report to the Village Administrative Officer / Sanitary Inspector within 21 days for free registration.
deadline: Free within 21 days of birth; late fee applies from 21-30 days; Magistrate/RDO permission needed after 1 year

name: Death Certificate (இறப்புச் சான்றிதழ்)
short_description: Official legal document stating the date, fact, and cause of death of an individual, vital for settling property inheritance, insurance claims, bank accounts, and pensions.
benefits: Legally settles insurance claims, bank account transfers, family pension applications, and property succession.
required_documents: Medical Cause of Death Certificate / Hospital Death Summary Form
Deceased Person's Aadhaar Card and Voter ID
Applicant / Informant Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card)
Smart Ration Card showing relation with the deceased
Cremation / Burial Ground Receipt
how_to_apply: Report to the local Registrar (Panchayat / Municipality / Corporation) within 21 days. Download digital copies from crsorgi.gov.in or the local municipal corporation website.
deadline: Free registration within 21 days of occurrence
